status: model of the two Workers built from subnet/coordinator (coordinator and eval). Measured: the Rust linear-memory peaks of the cohort steps (probe harness on the fan-out code, design section 1.3) and the workers-rs 0.8.7 glue (glue probe). Not yet measured on this build: the JS heap through the inspector and the painted stack high-water (design migration step 0). The build therefore uses the arena's unmeasured-model feature, which the arena accepts only together with observe (migration step 1: nothing the pool can physically serve is refused, every would-be refusal and overdraft is counted), and links growable linear memory under the ceiling below (the coordinator's build.rs; a fixed memory, initial = maximum, only once the arena enforces), so each isolate holds the linear memory it uses; /status reports the per-route peaks, the JS-side outcomes and the stack high-water of the deployed instances, the inputs of the measured model that Enforce needs.
page_bytes_source: WebAssembly page size, equal to the dlmalloc 0.2.12 system granularity
isolate_bytes_source: Cloudflare Workers limits: "128 MB per isolate", read as 10^6 bytes, the smaller of the two readings
js_reserve_bytes_source: the remainder beside a linear memory ceiling of 1,536 pages (100,663,296 B = 96 MiB; growable in the observe build): the largest measured Rust linear-memory peak of any step, the package step at the load instance's largest rehearsed shape (R_0 + 128 jobs, n = 1,000: 83.31 MiB, probe harness 2026-10-31, design section 1.3), plus the module's static data and stack (at most arena_routes::STATIC_UPPER_BYTES = 3 MiB, the 1 MiB stack and 2 MiB of data, by the rule measured static end page-rounded plus a stated margin: 2,173,704 B, 34 pages, measured on the release wasm32 module of commit f562a6d6 with the compiled-in scorer token table by examples/arena_wasm_check, 2026-11-04, leaving a 14-page margin; 1.4 MB measured fresh in the live ChainJournal status before that table, TESTNET.md; the deployed instance's static_bytes with the table is not yet read) and the glue partition, rounded up to 96 MiB as the stated margin. The live R_0 + 128 rehearsal (load-s2-r0p128-n1000) packaged with Rust linear memory near that peak and no invocation failed on memory, so its JS fitted beside it. Not measured through the inspector (design migration step 0).
js_envelope_bytes_source: not measured: twice the largest body any route holds in JS before admitting it into linear memory, the 4 MiB large RPC reply (rpc::MAX_LARGE_RESPONSE_BYTES), as the ArrayBuffer and its chunks
glue_static_bytes_source: the workers-rs 0.8.7 glue probe (subnet/crates/arena/glue-probe/memory-model.json, local workerd 2026-10-23, round2 run probe1): idle glue 872 B (hand-written exports), rounded up to the next power of two as the stated margin; the coordinator's lockfile pins the same worker, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions
glue_ticket_bytes_source: the glue probe's largest measured glue per entry with every export hand-written, one ticket per entry: 304 B (waitUntil continuation), rounded up to the next power of two; the coordinator's hand-written exports (cf_arena.rs) follow the probe's admitted pattern. The fan-out lane objects keep worker-macros exports until they are wrapped (their glue spills, counted)
glue_resident_bytes_source: the glue probe: 24 B per co-resident Durable Object instance (wasm-bindgen's Rc<WasmRefCell<T>> of a class holding handles), rounded up to the next power of two; the hand-written ChainJournal and EvalCohort classes hold a handle and a resident token, their state lives in a home scope
min_route_bytes_source: the smallest route control footprint, a Durable Object constructor's storage migration (arena_routes::CONSTRUCTOR_CONTROL_BYTES; checked by arena_routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table)
largest_route_bytes_source: the package step's invocation at the load instance's largest rehearsed shape, R_0 + 128 jobs at n = 1,000 with 1,000 tasks a job: the alarm's scope (1 MiB control, 18 pages), the step's child scope (arena_routes::package_bytes(129, 1000) = 87,463,002 B, an upper-bound fit to the measured 83.31 MiB; 1,336 pages) and the step's in-flight summary blocks (arena_routes::package_reads_bytes(1000): 6 reads of at most summary_bytes(1000) = 44,384 B, one page each), 1,360 pages (arena_routes::package_invocation_bytes, checked at build time); plans whose package needs more are refused at /plan
stack_bytes_source: rustc wasm32-unknown-unknown links the stack first with rust-lld's default -z stack-size=1048576 (scratch probe, 2026-10-31); the pool starts above static data, so the stack is outside every arena
stack_high_water_bytes_source: not measured on this build: the glue probe's 3,912 B (every workers-rs entry kind) is a lower bound for the coordinator's deeper handlers; /status reports the painted high-water of the deployed instances (stack_high_water)
